Online payments on your site

We connect your site to the payment methods your customers in Egypt actually use.

InstaPay

QR code and payment address, and the customer uploads the transfer receipt.

Mobile wallets

Vodafone Cash, Orange, Etisalat and WE Pay.

Fawry

A reference code payable at any Fawry outlet, or cards via FawryPay.

Bank cards

Visa, Mastercard and Meeza via Paymob or similar.

Bank transfer

Account details with receipt upload and confirmation from the dashboard.

Installments

valU, sympl, souhoola and contact via the payment gateway.

Cash on delivery

For stores, with order confirmation on WhatsApp.

PayPal

For customers outside Egypt.

Two levels of integration

Included in the package

Payment details and QR on the site, the customer uploads the receipt, and the order reaches you on WhatsApp and email.

Add-on: direct gateway

Automatic payment by card, wallet and Fawry via Paymob or FawryPay, with orders confirmed automatically.

A payment gateway account is opened in the business owner's name (commercial register and tax card). Until it's active, the site runs on receipts as usual.
